exposure: Race/ethnicity (non-Hispanic Whites, non-Hispanic Blacks, non-Hispanic Asians, and Hispanics)
cohort: US pregnant women from the CDC Natality Live Birth database for 2016-2018 who underwent ECV (n=26,255)
finding: Non-Hispanic Black women had the highest ECV success rate compared to non-Hispanic White women, Hispanic women, and non-Hispanic Asian women.
